text:
kai: Heads-up — saw a latency spike in prod around 16:30 UTC for short contexts (<=32). P50 jumped from 18ms to 65ms. Traces point to kernel chooser selecting large-MMA kernel on Ampere during prefill. Attaching a quick profile dump.

henry: yikes. Did autotune kick? Which signal triggered the switch?

kai: autotune log shows "score_long_kernel > threshold" because batch grouping combined two short reqs into a longer pipeline -> seqlen estimate inflated. snippet:

```
[autotune] selecting kernel: large_mma
reason: expected avg_slen=120, batch_size=4
metrics: score=0.87 (prev small_mma=0.65)
```

sophie: can we gate selection by per-request max_slen not batch avg? I thought we already had that.

aj: we only use avg_slen for selection to optimize throughput. But fallback exists for decode path when kv_hit low.

kai: Root cause: batching heuristic that merges front-loaded prefill tokens with decode tokens, causing avg to skew. KV cache hit flags are not being respected during prefill path's kernel pick.

henry: That suggests we need a quick hotfix — prefer small_kernels when max_slen < 64 OR kv_prefill==true.

sophie: agreed. Also need a postmortem metric: percent of requests with "kernel_mismatch" label.

aj: I'll put up a canary patch: 1) add max_slen check, 2) ensure kv_prefill flag participates in kernel score. Rolling to 10% of svc.

deploy-bot: deploy started by aj — canary 10% — id: deploy-2794000-canary :rocket:

kai: after canary 10min — p50 back to 20ms on canary. Prod remaining hosts still regressing. Suggest auto fallback if latency increase >2x within 60s.

sophie: add a mitigation to runtime: on kernel pick, simulate expected decode latency using per-kernel cost table and if predicted > target then fallback.

henry: also log per-request kernel_choice_rationale to help autotune.

aj: will push change, add unit tests, and schedule a follow-up sync. Putting a short checklist:

- [ ] patch: include max_slen gating
- [ ] runtime: predicted-latency check
- [ ] telemetry: kernel_mismatch, rationale log
- [ ] canary roll, monitor 5m p95

kai: thanks. filing a ticket RT-7893 with traces and profile dump. Anyone want to pair on perf test tomorrow?

sophie: I'll join 11am PT. :calendar:
